nodes.name: 01-evolved-prompt.json
nodes.summary: Records the result of a prompt evolution experiment run on 2026-04-14, storing the baseline prompt, the evolved (winner) prompt for a coding assistant, the performance delta, winner ID/score breakdown, and iteration history count.

nodes.name: 02a-arm-a-outputs.json
nodes.summary: Contains the LLM-generated outputs for Arm A (baseline prompt) across 10 diverse coding questions used in a prompt-evolution A/B/C experiment, covering topics like JS map/forEach, SQL joins, TypeScript types, Rust lifetimes, and Python concurrency.

nodes.name: 02b-arm-b-outputs.json
nodes.summary: Contains the LLM-generated outputs for Arm B (an alternative evolved prompt) across the same 10 coding questions used in the prompt-evolution experiment, providing a comparison dataset for judge scoring.

nodes.name: 02c-arm-c-outputs.json
nodes.summary: Contains the LLM-generated outputs for Arm C (another evolved prompt variant) across the same 10 coding questions, completing the three-arm dataset for the prompt-evolution hypothesis test.

nodes.name: 03-judge-scores.json
nodes.summary: Comprehensive judge-score dataset (~1,113 lines) from four LLM judges (Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Grok 4.20) evaluating all three arms across every question on correctness, procedure-following, and conciseness dimensions.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured as a nested object keyed by judge model, then arm (A/B/C), then question ID, making cross-judge comparison straightforward to query programmatically.
